items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: they ain't said much about baby Dutch yet, but in the near future you go hear a lot of talk about him.

ctx.x: Often it happens that way. Now you see, they ain't said much about baby Dutch yet, but in the near future you go hear a lot of talk about him. See, you don't hear all anybody saying nothing now, but you never can, can tell what's going to come up later on.
No. Did you ever hear a few of the other drummers I'll ask you about, like Old Man Cottrell, we were talking about his stuff earlier?
